rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a person or organization that uses, or threatens, political violence.

example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 laai1 zo2 go3 hung2 bou3 fan1 zi2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose modifier for something relating to terrorism, such as a terrorist group or terrorist activity.

example.english: Police say this is a terrorist organization.
example.traditional: 警方話呢個係恐怖主義嘅組織。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 waa6 ni1 go3 hai6 hung2 bou3 zyu2 ji6 ge3 zou2 zik1
